blocks.text:
Private transfer (driver only) from Rio de Janeiro’s Galeão airport to your hotel in Copacabana. Free day.

The blue ocean calls you to the beach: Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon are famous for their black-and-white mosaic promenades, where from early morning until late at night people play football and volleyball on the golden sand. Rio offers almost any sport, from golf, tennis and surfing to diving and hang-gliding; beach cafés serve coconut water and freshly squeezed juices, and local musicians often play on the beach.
